claims.statement: Official program guidance says payment applications follow completed work and gives specific invoice and proof-of-payment content requirements that the relevant regional fund reviews.
Current official guidance says an accredited program operator is mandatory for prefinancing and the highest support tier, creating a concentrated institutional distribution surface.

contrary_evidence: Program operators offer beneficiaries free support, constraining direct-to-consumer pricing.
The official GWD workflow and future improvements may absorb basic completeness checks.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: prove reduced clarification cycles for one operator or installer network, then sell through operator training groups.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 80 operator organizations plus installer accounts could produce 5 to 7 million PLN ARR; profitable renewal and program-adjacent expansion could support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in years 6 to 9.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 20 hours weekly during a single-region pilot, then under 15 hours after reviewer operations are delegated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65% initial gross margin with reviewer sampling, improving toward 80% as checks become deterministic.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 10000 PLN institutional pilot repays within six retained months at 3500 PLN monthly and 60% contribution margin.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 180 PLN per completed case or 3500 PLN per operator-month.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: each beneficiary case repeats, while rule changes reinforce the need for a maintained evidence engine.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A versioned defect library mapping device, invoice, protocol, region, rule version, and clarification outcome
fingerprint.customer: Czyste Powietrze operators, municipalities, energy auditors, and installer networks
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Operator organizations, municipal associations, auditor networks, and installation franchises
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: B2G/B2B disbursement-operations SaaS with per-case verification
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: An operator organization or installer network pays per payment pack that receives an internal completeness hash
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A retrofit is finished and the evidence package must be complete before a payment application is filed

founder_fit: The family installer can supply a lawful process pilot with consented synthetic or redacted records.
Document extraction and reconciliation fit the founder's data and AI skills.
Institutional channels reduce the need for high-energy consumer sales.
risks: Program rules and budgets can change abruptly.
Installers could misuse a pass token as a promise of reimbursement.
Sensitive household documents require strict minimization, access controls, and EU hosting.

structure.control_point: Operator-issued completeness hash before payment-application submission
structure.critical_dependency: Program continuity and institutional willingness to adopt a third-party evidence layer

thesis: A B2B evidence compiler for Czyste Powietrze operators, municipalities, auditors, and installer networks could bind invoices, payment proofs, device identifiers, energy-audit outputs, acceptance protocols, and site evidence into one versioned payment pack. The operator would issue a completeness hash before the applicant submits to GWD, making payment readiness measurable without charging vulnerable beneficiaries for official help.
title: Clean Air Disbursement Pack for Program Operators
uncertainties: Actual resubmission delays and document-defect rates require direct measurement.
Municipal procurement cycles may be too slow for an initial wedge.
The 60000 PLN capital figure and all commercial numbers below are hypotheses.
